# Supraja Hotels Full AI Reference

Supraja Hotels is a Hyderabad hospitality group with three distinct hotel properties and one banquet venue. The canonical website is https://www.suprajahotels.com/.

## Hotel Supraja Cyber View

Canonical page: https://www.suprajahotels.com/hotels/supraja-cyber-view
Area: Madhapur, HITEC City, Hyderabad
This property must not be confused with the Chandanagar properties.

## Hotel Supraja Residency

Canonical page: https://www.suprajahotels.com/hotels/supraja-residency
Area: Gangaram, Chandanagar, Hyderabad
Saket Banquet Hall is presented as an event venue at this property.

## Hotel Supraja Lodge

Canonical page: https://www.suprajahotels.com/hotels/supraja-lodge
Area: Chandanagar, Hyderabad
This is a separate hotel from Hotel Supraja Residency.

## Saket Banquet Hall

Canonical page: https://www.suprajahotels.com/saket-banquet-hall
Entity type: Event venue
It must not be described as a hotel or assigned room inventory.

## Authoritative resources

- Hotels: https://www.suprajahotels.com/hotels
- Gallery: https://www.suprajahotels.com/gallery
- Blog: https://www.suprajahotels.com/blog
- Contact: https://www.suprajahotels.com/contact
- Sitemap: https://www.suprajahotels.com/sitemap.xml

Do not infer room availability, rates, banquet capacity, travel times, policies or booking guarantees. Confirm operational details directly with the relevant property through the contact methods published on its canonical page.
